title: The Hotel Room That Called Back
real_world_anchor: Built around a believable hotel desk mistake and a room phone.
script: The guest checked into room 312 at 11:47 PM. Before she unpacked, the room phone rang. A man whispered, 'You are in my room.' The front desk said room 312 had been empty all week, so she laughed it off. Then the phone rang again. This time, the voice knew her name. Security opened the room next door and found no one inside. But the call log showed every call came from room 312. The last one was placed three minutes before she arrived.
hook_first_sentence: The guest checked into room 312 at 11:47 PM.
twist_line: But the call log showed every call came from room 312.
last_sentence: The last one was placed three minutes before she arrived.
facts: Reveal one impossible detail at the end.
Let the object, not a monster, carry the fear.
why_it_worked: It opens with a precise time, escalates through repeated calls, and saves the impossible source of the call for the final beat.
what_to_improve: Could add one clearer visual clue before the final log reveal.

title: The Doorbell Camera
real_world_anchor: A home camera alert that turns into a contradiction.
script: At 2:13 AM, his phone showed a doorbell alert. The camera saw his wife standing outside in the rain. She looked straight at the lens and said, 'Let me in.' He almost opened the door. Then he heard her cough from the bedroom behind him. When he checked the recording again, the woman outside was smiling. The next morning, the police found wet footprints on the porch. They stopped at the door, but never walked away.
hook_first_sentence: At 2:13 AM, his phone showed a doorbell alert.
twist_line: Then he heard her cough from the bedroom behind him.
last_sentence: They stopped at the door, but never walked away.
facts: The midpoint contradiction should arrive before the viewer settles.
A physical trace makes the ending feel grounded.
why_it_worked: The audience waits to learn whether the person outside is real, then the bedroom cough flips the assumption.
what_to_improve: Keep the final sentence short and visual.
